title: The questions to ask them, and what the answers give away

videos.script: At the end of every interview, somebody asks: do you have any questions for us? {{end}} Most candidates say no, or ask something they could have read on the website. Both waste the only part of the process where you are the one finding things out. {{waste}} You are deciding too. Whether the team will teach you, whether the work is what the advert said, and whether the people are people you want to spend a year with. {{deciding}} This lesson gives you questions whose answers tell you something, shows how to read those answers, and uses the last five minutes to leave the process clear.
